Fixed Covariance Matrix

Source: R/mxHelper-sigma-fixed.R
MxHelperSigmaFixed.Rd

Builds a covariance matrix with no free elements, from values or, when values = NULL, from type, as MxHelperSigmaFromLDLMxMatrix() does. The model must hold the identity matrix iden_name. The arguments are checked first; the internal version, without checks, is the one other projects copy.

Usage

MxHelperSigmaFixed(p, values, row, name, iden_name = NULL, type)

Arguments

p

Positive integer. Number of rows and columns of the square matrix.

values

Numeric matrix or NULL. Covariance matrix. If NULL, set by type.

row

Character vector or NULL. Names of the variables (rows and columns).

name

Character string. Name of the matrix or algebra.

iden_name

Character string or NULL. Name of the identity matrix, which the model must hold. If NULL, <name>_iden.

type

Character string or NULL. Covariance when values = NULL: "zero" (1e-10 times the identity), "identity", or "diffused" (1e10 times the identity). The algebra adds 1e-8 to each element of the diagonal of the LDL decomposition, so "zero" evaluates to (1e-10 + 1e-8) times the identity.

Value

Returns a named list of OpenMx matrices and algebras.

See also

Other Covariance Matrix Functions: MxHelperInvLDL(), MxHelperInvSoftplus(), MxHelperLDL(), MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLMxMatrix(), MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLFixed(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLLogAlgebra(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLMxMatrix(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra(), MxHelperSoftplus()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

MxHelperSigmaFixed(
  p = 2,
  values = NULL,
  row = c("y1", "y2"),
  name = "sigma",
  iden_name = NULL,
  type = "identity"
)
#> $sigma_l
#> SdiagMatrix 'sigma_l' 
#> 
#> $labels: No labels assigned.
#> 
#> $values
#>    y1 y2
#> y1  0  0
#> y2  0  0
#> 
#> $free: No free parameters.
#> 
#> $lbound: No lower bounds assigned.
#> 
#> $ubound: No upper bounds assigned.
#> 
#> 
#> $sigma_d
#> FullMatrix 'sigma_d' 
#> 
#> $labels: No labels assigned.
#> 
#> $values
#>      sigma_d
#> y1 0.5413249
#> y2 0.5413249
#> 
#> $free: No free parameters.
#> 
#> $lbound: No lower bounds assigned.
#> 
#> $ubound: No upper bounds assigned.
#> 
#> 
#> $sigma
#> mxAlgebra 'sigma' 
#> $formula:  (sigma_l + sigma_iden) %*% vec2diag(((sigma_d + abs(sigma_d))/2 + mxRobustLog(1 + exp(-abs(sigma_d)))) + 1e-08) %*% t(sigma_l + sigma_iden) 
#> $result: (not yet computed) <0 x 0 matrix>
#> dimnames: NULL
#> 
#> $sigma_vech
#> mxAlgebra 'sigma_vech' 
#> $formula:  vech(sigma) 
#> $result: (not yet computed) <0 x 0 matrix>
#> dimnames: NULL
#>
